A hot air balloon is ascending at a constant rate. The graph shows the estimated altitude $y$, in meters, of the balloon $x$ minutes after it begins ascending. What is the estimated altitude, in meters, of the balloon $7$ minutes after it begins ascending?
explanation: Choice C is correct. The x-axis represents time, in minutes, and the y-axis represents altitude, in meters. Therefore, the estimated altitude, in meters, of the balloon $7$ minutes after it begins ascending is the y-coordinate of the point on the graph with an x-coordinate of $7$. That point has a y-coordinate of approximately $590$. Therefore, the estimated altitude is $590$ meters.
